LESSON: SELF-AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: Self-awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Self-awareness. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why are you a special creation?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God
   In simple words: practise until you can recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Self-awareness using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Self-awareness in the examples.
2. Explain Self-awareness to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Self-awareness.
4. Show that you can: recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Self-awareness using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Self-awareness important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Genesis 1:27 about being, ‘created in the image and likeness of God’
2. Sing a song related to their uniqueness. Why are you a special creation? 1

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise his or her uniqueness as a creation of God

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
